dataset_source: CIRDataset (Zenodo record 6762573, CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record); cite original LIDC-IDRI as well); LIDC-IDRI CT patches with expert nodule masks. Prepared by Role 2.
label_definition: Radiologist suspicion: 1–2 low (0), 4–5 high (1). NOT pathology-confirmed cancer.
label_positive_meaning: high radiologist suspicion (rating 4-5); NOT pathology-confirmed cancer
preprocessing_note: theta = pi * sigmoid((feature - train_mean) / train_scale) (train-split mean/scale only; angles in (0, pi))
unit: One supplied canonical NID=1 patch per included LIDC patient
test_labels: held by Role 2 until models and thresholds are frozen
role2_status: Real data baseline completed; quantum model not implemented by Role 2
limitations: Selected clear-rating cases; not representative of all nodules.
Expert-provided segmentations required, not automated diagnosis from arbitrary CT.
Stored intensities are preprocessed, not raw HU.
Voxel-grid size is not physical volume and can depend on resampling.
Prediction scores are not established calibrated clinical probabilities.
One validation split; confidence interval is conditional on this split.
8 alternate-scan identifiers excluded rather than guessing label mappings.
